text: I'd like you to make me a watercolor picture of a lighthouse. I've always found coastal scenes calming, so that's why I'm asking for this. The lighthouse should be red-and-white striped, and the picture should be wide. Put it on a rocky coast at dusk. I sometimes worry that I over-explain simple picture ideas, but I just want to make sure I've described what I mean. Please don't include any writing.
